panels.title: Model calls by provider
panels.query: count(spans) where gen_ai.operation.name = 'generate_content' group by gen_ai.provider.name

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.query: sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) where gen_ai.operation.name = 'generate_content' group by gen_ai.request.model

panels.title: Tool latency p95
panels.query: p95(duration) where gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' group by gen_ai.tool.name

panels.title: Agent invocations
panels.query: count(spans) where gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' group by gen_ai.agent.name
